name: What should I prepare before contacting Hometelligent Inc. about an ADU project?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting Hometelligent Inc. about an ADU project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting Hometelligent Inc. for your ADU project, it's helpful to have a clear idea of your primary goals for the ADU (e.g., rental, family, office), a rough estimate of your budget, and any preferred design styles or features. Gathering any existing property surveys, site plans, or previous renovation plans can also be very useful. Even a simple sketch of where you envision the ADU on your property can help us understand your vision and accelerate the initial consultation process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before contacting us, have your ADU goals, budget, design preferences, and any existing property documents ready to streamline the process.
